description: Show side-page translation status for a landing page in one language. Returns { variantSlug, items: [{ slug, name, type, sourcePublished, translated, translatedPublished }] }. `variantSlug` is null if the landing page has no variant in that language yet (use create_landing_page_translation first).

language.description: Target language, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs.

name: get_side_page_translations
